:::{#rem-nested-cv}
#### What is nested

Each [fold-out fitted model](#def-fold-out-fitted-model) of $\candproctuned{\text{CV}}$
is computed from the observations outside one outer [fold](#def-folds) $\fold{\ifold}$,
so the whole choice,
including the cross-validation that $\candproctuned{\text{CV}}$ runs inside those observations,
never sees $\fold{\ifold}$.
That inner cross-validation is the nested one.

:::
